crossRefs.note: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
“Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of…
About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in…
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.
The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
